claim: *Processing one document in DocAble.* A user submits a document, creating a job that tracks its processing. The work may be divided into chunks and processed by workers using specialized services for generation, rendering, optical character recognition (OCR), and document-format processing. The resulting changes are reassembled and validated, and the remediated document is returned with evidence.

topology.description: Processing fork/join; workers call specialist services while repaired pieces rejoin.

required_terms: Specialized services Generation · render · OCR Document / format machinery
bw_encoding: Grayscale publication candidate. Neutral processing nodes contrasted with document input/output; explicit fork/join and specialist-service side call retained.
redesign: Neutral processing nodes contrasted with document input/output; explicit fork/join and specialist-service side call retained.
alt: A submitted document creates a tracked job, which splits into chunks processed by workers. Workers call generation, rendering, OCR and document-format services. Repaired pieces rejoin, are validated and return as a remediated document with evidence of consequential changes. The fork and join distinguish concurrent work from its shared job. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings.
